purpose: Test whether the existing public alert text supports useful score-only suppression before investing in full evidence-gate data acquisition.
authorization: User explicitly requested working around the hurdles; this prospective amendment releases a limited local exploratory benchmark without pretending full G0 passed.
split_rule: Deterministic hash of seed and grouping-only normalized feature hash; no label-stratification, seed selection or score-based adjustment.
grouping_limit: Normalizing valid IPv4 literals reduces duplicate leakage but does not establish independent incidents, campaign novelty or temporal generalization.
representative: Lowest original source-row ordinal per normalized group in every role; model input retains original serialized evidence.
exclusions: Every normalized group containing any of the50 reserved human-review source rows
Every normalized group with conflicting binary labels
secondary_unit: All retained test rows with groups resampled intact
scorer: Existing frozen character-TFIDF plus LinearSVC; label1=Attack; benignness=-decision_function; no hyperparameter search
features: Existing serialize_features whitelist; labels, derived attack/kill-chain tags and randomized top-level addresses/ports excluded; original text remains unchanged
selection_use: Diagnostic reporting only; no model or threshold choice
calibration: One attack representative per retained calibration group; no eligibility predicates in this pilot; threshold frozen before test scoring
uncertainty: Empirical group-resampling percentile intervals. These are not verified independent-incident population confidence intervals; zero-event bootstrap degeneracy must be disclosed.
success_interpretation: Report all results. Useful observed suppression is a preliminary signal, not confirmation of original H1/H2/H3, two-dataset utility, production safety or novelty.
pre_run_exposure: Public artifact schema, aggregate labels, exact/IPv4-normalized group counts and planned split class counts inspected. No scorer fitted or performance results inspected before this release.
human_review: Pending and reserved; Gary may conduct a genuine documented single-rater audit. Completing50 reviews does not automatically reach45 agreements; unable cases remain in the denominator.
data_terms: SecAlertBench repository has no located license. Only local exploratory analysis of the already acquired public research artifact is released here; this amendment does not establish permission, redistribute data or approve confirmatory G0.
future_confirmation: This pilot test becomes observed data after the run. Later confirmation must disclose reuse and obtain new independent evidence; a fresh random split is not a new dataset.
tier3_parallel_scope: Two small published SIABench CIC PCAPNG cases may be replayed offline through pinned Suricata for packet-linkage feasibility only. Scenario labels must not be copied onto every regenerated alert. A network-only predicate redesign and validated label joins require separate registration before efficacy.
